mapper.select: select exam_infos.id as e_id, exam_date, comments, exam_infos.subject_id, exam_infos.grade_id, subjects.id, subjects.subject, grades.id as g_id, grades.grade, places.id as p_id, places.place from exam_infos join subjects on subject_id = subjects.id join grades on grade_id = grades.id join places on place_id = places.id where exam_infos.id = #{examId}

select exam_infos.id as e_id, exam_date, exam_infos.comments, exam_infos.cancel, subjects.id, subjects.subject, grades.id as g_id, grades.grade, places.id as p_id, places.place from exam_infos join subjects on subject_id = subjects.id join grades on grade_id = grades.id join places on place_id = places.id where exam_date >= curdate() order by exam_date asc, subject_id asc, grade_id asc, place_id asc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
mapper.insert: insert into exam_infos (subject_id, grade_id, exam_date, place_id) values (#{subjectId}, #{gradeId}, #{examDate}, #{placeId} )
